_about: TRANSLATOR SHELF: Charles Wharton Stork (1881-1971): Modern Swedish Masterpieces (1923) and Söderberg's Martin Birck's Youth (Harper, 1930); the Anthology of Swedish Lyrics (1917) and Heidenstam's The Charles Men, Part I (1920), both American-Scandinavian Foundation, added in round 90. Printings before 1931 only. US public domain. Added 2026-10-10 by lane C (round 33); Adam may veto. No uids minted.
